title: Email templates are not escaped
prompt:
`render(template, data)` in src/template.js fills `{{name}}` placeholders for notification emails, but it injects
raw HTML (`<script>` from a user's name ends up in the email), fails on nested keys like `{{user.name}}` and prints
`undefined` for missing values. Fix it: values are HTML-escaped (`& < > " '`), dotted paths are followed, whitespace
inside the braces is allowed (`{{ user.name }}`), missing values render as an empty string, and `{{{raw}}}` (three
braces) inserts the value without escaping.
